title: Odile and the Echo
author: Noor Villalobos
blurb: Lior Nakamura, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
